Package io.telekom.orchest.cache.config

Class CacheAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.cache.config.CacheAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="orchest.caching", name="enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) @EnableConfigurationProperties(CacheProperties.class) public class CacheAutoConfiguration extends Object
Spring Boot auto-configuration entry point.

Activation rules:

  • Mongo driver must be on the classpath (no point if the host can't talk to Mongo).
  • telekom.cache.enabled must not be false.

      @Bean(name="cacheRefreshScheduler", destroyMethod="shutdown") @ConditionalOnMissingBean(name="cacheRefreshScheduler") public org.springframework.scheduling.TaskScheduler cacheRefreshScheduler(CacheProperties props)
      Dedicated scheduler for cache refreshes. Separated from any host-provided TaskScheduler so a slow refresh can't starve other scheduled work.
